title: Needleman-Wunsch, cell by cell
instructions:
## Align two short DNA sequences

Global alignment finds the best way to line up two whole sequences, inserting gaps where needed. Here a match scores **+1**, a mismatch **−1** and a gap **−1**.

The first sequence (rows) is **GATTACA** and the second (columns) is **GCATGCA**.

## Do this

1. Step through the matrix fill. Each cell takes the best of three moves: diagonal (align two letters), down (gap in the second sequence) or right (gap in the first).
2. Watch the traceback from the bottom-right corner, which prefers diagonal, then up, then left.
hints: F[1][1] compares G with G: max(0 + 1, −1 − 1, −1 − 1).
The bottom-right cell is the alignment score.
In the alignment, a dash marks a gap.
